title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: chat panel opens by default in Gallery view
summary: The default behaviour, release details and Teams Rooms Pro licensing are supported. However, the controls table tells administrators that no UI control is documented even though Microsoft's release notes explicitly document a local setting and portal management; the unpublished Android setting label must not be presented as an absence of configuration.

claims.claim: Teams Android devices have a local device administrator account for access to device settings.
claims.quote: Teams Android devices include an administrative account to access device settings, the local web server (if installed), and any OEM specific settings.

claims.claim: Initial local administrator credentials can be obtained from the device manufacturer.
claims.quote: Initial device setup and configuration items such as the default username and password for this account can be obtained from the device manufacturer.

claims.claim: The chat-default release description describes no change to sign-in, permissions or meeting admission.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android chat panel default local device setting Gallery PowerShell Microsoft Graph API configuration; read roadmap and June 2026 chat paragraph at rooms/rooms-release-note?tabs=Android. Neither describes identity or admission changes for this feature.

claims.claim: The release description of this feature describes no agent or automated action beyond opening the panel by default.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android chat panel default local device setting Gallery PowerShell Microsoft Graph API configuration; read the June 2026 chat paragraph at rooms/rooms-release-note?tabs=Android. It describes panel display and controls, not an agent.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and api; Governance controls: rendered table and lead
claims.claim: No UI or automation control is documented for the Android chat-panel default, so there is nothing to configure on either surface yet.
claims.quote:
IT admins can change the chat panel default behavior using a local device setting.
Management of settings related to features in this release and future releases is only available within the Teams Rooms Pro management portal
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].ui with surface 'Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal', path 'Rooms > device > Settings', docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/pro-portal-settings', and cite that page. Keep api null. Replace the row note with 'This path reaches the device settings page; the Android chat-default setting label is not yet documented. Settings management requires a signed-in device and Rooms Management permissions. The June 2026 release notes require Teams Admin Agent 1.0.0.202606082157 or greater.' Do not use the Windows-only 'Open Chat by Default' label for Android.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell operation for setting the Android chat-panel default is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams PowerShell Microsoft Graph teamsDevice configuration "chat" "default" Android; read results for Get-MgBetaTeamworkDeviceConfiguration and teamworkdeviceconfiguration-get, plus rooms/pro-portal-settings. Results document reading configuration, not setting this default.
